heading: Our founder’s dog: a three-clip diary
intro: These are videos of our founder’s own dog, supplied by the owner in the sequence below as a personal account of the dog’s progress. This is a founder-submitted testimonial, with a commercial connection to Peptides4Pets; it is not an independently assessed veterinary case study.
context: The recording dates, interval between clips, diagnosis and complete treatment history have not been verified. Different settings and selected moments cannot establish improvement or what caused it. Clip 1 includes an injection and is not an untreated baseline or an administration guide. Discuss mobility concerns and treatment decisions with your South African veterinarian.
editing: Published in the supplied order. Audio has been removed; the full visual duration of each supplied clip is retained. Videos are compressed for mobile viewing and play only when you choose.
